themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple continents are intensifying campaign machinery, formalizing re-election bids, and framing upcoming elections as existential national tests. From Vox in Spain to Javier Milei in Argentina and PiS in Poland, leaders are promising sweeping tax rollbacks and nationalist alliances to consolidate power.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal launches aggressive rallies for upcoming elections, targeting Prime Minister Sánchez and ruling out coalition compromises.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei officially confirms his 2027 re-election bid, pledging massive tax rollbacks and structural reforms.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen maintains strong presidential polling leads while Jordan Bardella rallies voters around conservative governance models.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Jarosław Kaczyński outlines a grand right-wing alliance and economic platforms aimed at retaking government in 2027.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Sylvi Listhaug launches campaign initiatives focusing on regional power gains amid strong national polling momentum.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson exercises major leverage over center-right coalition negotiations, positioning SD for expanded influence.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Legal scrutiny, party ban procedures, and judicial decisions targeting right-wing leaders dominate political coverage across several democracies. Courts and prosecutors are actively adjudicating cases ranging from corruption scandals and electoral eligibility to press blockades and ban motions.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (STF) reviews appeals on Jair Bolsonaro's conviction while ruling his social media blocks violated press freedom.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Protests and political initiatives demand a formal constitutional ban procedure ('Verbotsverfahren') against the AfD.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Anti-corruption authorities uncover millions in buried cash connected to former Fidesz minister Miklós Seszták.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Federal judges block administration projects while Republican senators resist rapid judicial appointments.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Magistrates and legal commentators debate Marine Le Pen's presidential eligibility amid ongoing court proceedings.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements continue to double down on nativist rhetoric, linking illegal immigration to public insecurity and cultural erosion. Parties are demanding stricter border enforcement, restrictions on dual nationality, and local protectionist policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal and party candidates cite rising urban insecurity and campaign against external cultural and border influences.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD distributes targeted campaign materials demanding strict integration rules and state monitoring.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen recalibrates her stance on dual citizenship to reassure voters while maintaining sovereign protectionist framing.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Local chapters campaign against refugee housing facilities while facing state-level legal scrutiny for hate speech.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Conservative leaders are escalating attacks against state broadcasters, digital regulations, and social media platforms. Figures in Poland, Brazil, Italy, and Spain claim mainstream media channels and online algorithms are weaponized by political opponents.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Presidential vetoes target digital services legislation over claims it introduces state-sponsored internet censorship.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonarista figures collide with the judiciary over social media account blocks and journalist access.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini denounces widespread automated bot networks used to attack Lega officials online.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Abascal publicly criticizes major television outlets for perceived bias and unfair interview conditions.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders are actively reshaping their foreign policy positioning, managing foreign alliances, and maneuvering around international criticism. Figures across Europe and the Americas are balancing national defense imperatives with cross-border political strategy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen faces heavy executive pushback over plans to limit Ukraine aid while proposing direct diplomatic engagements.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage launches a national security review declaring Russia Britain's chief threat to counter claims of foreign sympathies.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro seeks permanent US residency while invoking foreign government reactions to question domestic election results.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei leverages high-profile corporate partnerships and international papal visits to project global standing.
